data.gender_notes: Mazmun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Mazmun is derived from the Arabic word 'mazmanah' which means 'a gift', 'a reward'. In Islamic context, it can be interpreted as a sign of Allah's blessings and mercy. The name Mazmun carries the meaning “Gift, Reward” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mazmun usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, reward and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes blessings and rewards from Allah.
data.etymology: Mazmun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Reward.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mazmun total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
